name: NSL Ltd
summary: NSL Ltd, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture and sale of building materials, oil and petroleum related products in Singapore, Malaysia, the United Arab Emirates, Finland, Norway, Germany, and internationally. It operates through three divisions: Precast & Prefabricated Bathroom Unit, Environmental Services, and Chemicals.
